basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old mechanical engineer living in the heart of Memphis. I grew up in Little Rock, but moved here a year and a half ago to be closer to my girlfriend who is pursuing her PhD. I'm a huge fan of dice-making and recently got into long rides on my new Himiway e-bike. I work regular hours but often find myself browsing Reddit during evenings and weekends. I'm passionate about gun rights due to growing up in areas where self-reliance is crucial. In my free time, I like to explore the city's rich music and cultural history. I'm in a committed relationship and enjoy spending my weekends checking out new restaurants or visiting local art galleries with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Arkansas, which has provided me with a solid foundation in technical problem-solving and design. My interests in firearms and self-defense stem from personal experiences and self-study, as well as discussions with fellow enthusiasts online and in-person. I'm always learning more about gun safety and laws to stay informed.
